description: Chlorophyll-a at CRP stations 13202, 15816 and 17410, pooled. Primary target: the event chlorophyll_a >= 10 ug/L on the sample date. Secondary: the concentration (log1p regression). Features are same-visit readings (a nowcast), not a multi-day forecast.

reference_comparison.note: independent probe: 131 labels, walk-forward by calendar year over test years 2018 to 2026, no final hold-out, 93 out-of-sample labels, 32 positives

baseline_meaning.base_rate: the share of positives among the training labels
baseline_meaning.persistence: the last sample at this station, carried forward (the previous label at the same station on a strictly earlier date; with no earlier label, the training base rate)
baseline_meaning.seasonal_climatology: the mean of the training targets within plus or minus 1 calendar month(s) of the test month, pooled over the task's stations (with fewer than 3 training labels in that window, the mean of all training targets)
